_comment: This file serves as the master reference for all inspection logic rules. Import into the DB via the Rules Engine admin page. Conditions reference question_id from the InspectionQuestion entity. operator options: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, in_list.

rules.description: Triggers when technician reports visible cracks in firebox
rules.output_narrative: Visible cracks were observed in the firebox brick and mortar joints. This condition can allow heat and combustion gases to penetrate the surrounding structure, creating a fire hazard. Immediate repair is recommended.

rules.description: Triggers when chimney cap is absent or damaged
rules.output_narrative: The chimney cap is either missing or in a damaged condition. A properly functioning chimney cap prevents water intrusion, animal entry, and debris accumulation in the flue.

rules.description: Triggers when chimney crown shows cracking or spalling
rules.output_narrative: The chimney crown shows signs of cracking or deterioration. A damaged crown allows water to seep into the chimney structure, accelerating freeze-thaw damage.

rules.description: Triggers when flashing is separated, rusted, or missing
rules.output_narrative: The chimney flashing is compromised. Failed flashing is a leading cause of roof leaks and water damage at the chimney-roof junction.

rules.description: Triggers when damper is broken or missing
rules.output_narrative: The throat damper is damaged or non-functional. A working damper is essential for draft control, energy efficiency, and preventing animal or weather infiltration when the fireplace is not in use.

rules.description: Triggers when liner shows cracks, gaps, or deterioration
rules.output_narrative: The masonry flue liner shows evidence of cracking, spalling, or gaps. A compromised liner is a serious safety hazard, allowing combustion gases including carbon monoxide to enter living spaces.

rules.description: Triggers when active or past water damage is present
rules.output_narrative: Evidence of water damage or moisture intrusion was identified. Chronic water exposure leads to accelerated deterioration of mortar, brick, and metal components.

rules.description: Triggers when smoke chamber corbeling is exposed or damaged
rules.output_narrative: The smoke chamber has exposed corbeling or is in need of parging. Parging smooths the smoke chamber walls, improving draft efficiency and reducing creosote accumulation.

rules.description: Triggers when liner cannot be fully inspected from interior
rules.output_narrative: The flue liner could not be fully inspected from the available access points. A Level 2 inspection with video scanning equipment is recommended to assess the full length of the liner.

rules.description: Triggers when heavy creosote (Stage 2 or 3) is identified
rules.output_narrative: Heavy creosote (Stage 2 or 3) was found in the flue. Stage 2/3 creosote is extremely flammable and a leading cause of chimney fires. Immediate professional cleaning and possible chemical treatment is required before using the appliance.

rules.description: Triggers when CO detector is absent or CO signs are present
rules.output_narrative: Carbon monoxide safety concerns were identified. CO detectors are absent or signs of CO exposure were observed. CO is an odorless, colorless gas that is immediately life-threatening at elevated concentrations.

rules.description: Triggers when creosote or debris buildup requires standard cleaning
rules.output_narrative: Light to moderate creosote or debris was found in the flue. A standard chimney sweep cleaning is recommended annually or after 1 cord of wood.

visibility_rules._comment: These extend per-question visibility. Set on InspectionQuestion records via visibility_rule JSON field.
